domain_instructions: Follow the industry chain in §3: demand, supply, capacity, utilization, pricing, margins, ROIC, capital entry/exit, future capacity. Use Porter's five forces only as context (§3.2). The Industry Specialist row in the scuttlebutt registry covers deep industry expertise and cross-company patterns. question: Does the CMS 2027 Medicare Advantage rate announcement, together with UnitedHealth's public star statement that at least 69 percent of plan enrollment sits in plans rated four stars or higher, show a company-specific funding gap versus the industry rate bridge (effective growth 5.33 percent, expected net 2.48 percent)?
